primary_source.current_title: Grounded autonomous scrutiny at scale: emergent critique from reproduction of published computational physics papers
primary_source.publication_status_observed: arXiv v2 states accepted at ICML 2026 AI for Science Workshop

findings.result: The worker source cites the v1 phase attribution 86/88=97.7% execution-bound and 1/111=0.9% reading-only. Current arXiv v2 explicitly corrects this to 85/88=96.6% and 2/111=1.8%; the older figures are superseded.

The v2 appendix reports that critique-phase classification is post hoc and single-coder audited. A blinded independent LLM recoding agrees on only 66/88 rows (kappa=0.16); all disagreements move cases toward reading-detected, reducing the execution-bound share to 71.6%. The paper therefore explicitly labels 96.6% coding-sensitive.

The paper explicitly states that execution-dependent is a positional label rather than a causal estimate. No matched same-model/tools/budget comparison of prose-only terminal review versus mandatory reproduce-before-promote was located. The hard gate is therefore an O/worker adaptation, not a demonstrated causal result of this source.

Current v2 reports 111 papers, 571 quantitative claims, 75.8% reproduced within 5%, 83.2% within 10%, median deviation 0.9%, 88 critique instances across 47/111 papers, and a 12-paper independent-machine cross-check with overlapping critique categories on 7/12. The cross-machine check is internal to the primary study, not third-party replication.

Current v2 says production inputs/outputs/traces, prompts, verdict JSONs, verified pipeline, cross-machine subset and figure scripts will be released upon publication. Targeted current searches did not locate a public exact replay bundle/repository for this scrutiny experiment. Absence is not proven; exact replay remains unverified until a source-matched archive is located.
Targeted searches did not locate a protocol-matched third-party rerun of the 111-paper scrutiny experiment. Current numerical headline evidence remains primary-study evidence.

The paper's depth case records a human reviewer catching an acoustic-branch interpretation error and citation-fidelity lapses in an agent-produced artifact. Execution grounds numerical claims but is not sufficient by itself for interpretation or citation correctness.

safe_transfer: For executable quantitative science, reproduction/re-execution is strongly supported as a high-value evidence-acquisition stage and can surface defects that prose-only review misses. The strongest safe transfer is to require execution evidence when available before promoting a numerical claim, while keeping interpretation/citation review separate. Do not claim that a mandatory hard gate has itself been causally shown to improve terminal scientific quality.

scope_guard: This audit does not reject the value of execution-grounded scientific review. It narrows the worker's v1 headline to current v2 numbers, records that the phase attribution is coding-sensitive, and separates observational/positional evidence from the untested causal claim that a mandatory reproduce-before-promote actuator improves final review quality.
